text:
alex: Heads-up — during a quick perf sweep I noticed a repeating oscillation in p95 when the new slab-based batcher mixes KV-hit and miss traffic. Batch-slice sizes swing between ~6 and ~14 tokens and kernel selection flips rapidly.
perf-bot: CI perf snapshot 4999991111: p50 38ms, p95 340ms (+22%), kernel-switch-events 412 over 10m, kv-hit-rate 0.57
marta: ugh. do we have a repro script + trace? where is the p95 coming from (kv hits or misses)?
alex: attaching short trace excerpt below (trimmed). repro: small concurrent clients hitting same route with mixed short+long prompts, KV-prefetch enabled.
```
# simplified traces
batch[0]: slices=[6,14,6,14]; kernel=A,A,B,B; kv_hits=[1,0,1,0]
batch[1]: slices=[14,6,14]; kernel=B,A,B; latency_spike at kernel-switch ~+80ms
```
jin: hypothesis: selector too sensitive to sample median. slaber alternates slice sizes so selector flips. fast-quant-kernel chosen for small slices but kernel handoff cost dominates.
sam: seen this in microbenchmarks — handoff adds ~60-90ms if thread pools or caches cold. mixing KV-hit lanes amplifies it.
taylor: mitigations: 1) admission lanes (separate kv-hit lane) with independent token budgets; 2) hysteresis on kernel choice (lock kernel for N batches or ms); 3) batch-slice smoothing (avoid alternating small/large slices within an assembly).
marta: can we try the admission-lane idea first? propose: kv_hit lane token_budget=2000, miss lane=8000, prefer same-lane batches. should reduce kernel churn.
alex: agreed. experiment plan:
1) tag at ingress: lane=kv_hit if kv_prefetch_hit>0.6
2) per-lane token_budget: kv_hit=2000, default=8000
3) kernel_lock_ms=150 (config toggle)
4) collect kernel-switch-events, lane-merge-ratio, p50/p95 per lane
rollout: flag 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h if p95 delta < +5%
jin: also tweak batch-assembler: prefer append-slice-if-same-length-or-lane, else start new assembly window for a short grace period.
sam: i'll prototype an admission-lane gate in the runtime queue (cheap check) and push a canary image.
perf-bot: scheduled profiler run 10:30am UTC, will post histograms to #perf-dumps
marta: logging: tag traces with chosen_kernel and kernel_locked_until, emit a sample of full batch shape for offline analysis.
taylor: note: avoid starving long sequences if hit lane underbudgeted. add token_rebalance: if kv_hit_lane idle for Xms, allow steal up to 25% from default.
alex: good — add soft-steal threshold. also circuit: if kernel_switch_events/sec > 5 and p95 > baseline+10% -> revert kernel_lock and fall back to conservative kernel.
jin: tests: mixed-length synthetic, real-customer trace replay, high-kv-hit synthetic with low variance.
sam: PR created for runtime gate + config knobs: r/infer/queue/PR-847. includes test vectors.
marta: once PR is canaryed watch tail latency on the problematic hosts (us-west-2-g4).
alex: will follow up with a short write-up if the canary improves. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: dashboard link https://grafana.redwood.local/d/queue/4999991111-slab-batch-ops
taylor: long-term: kernel affinity hints from compilation stage so selector uses soft hints rather than binary thresholds — filed EPIC-312.
alex: scheduling quick sync tomorrow 11:00 to review canary results.
